author: bardic-inspiration
name: Candlewick Dagger
summary: A dagger whose pommel burns with a small steady flame on command.
description: Chandlers in the river towns forge these for night watchmen. The flame never drips, and it gutters when a liar speaks nearby.

stats.effect: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. As a Bonus Action, you can light or douse a flame on the pommel. While lit, the flame sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.
